content:
**Spin The Wheel Circus Tent** is an unmarked location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Nuka-World on Tour* update.

This unmarked location is where the Event: Spin The Wheel takes place. Players can walk in and around this area without the event active.

The tent is down the hill from the crafting hub in Nuka-World On Tour. Inside the tent there are rows of seating around the outer edge. In the very center, the giant wheel can be found which cannot be spun while the event is not active. On the left and right of the wheel there is a Cappy and Bottle statue.

Around the outside of the tent there are three statues of Bottle and Cappy that are utilized in the event, a yellow statue, a blue statue, and a red statue. There are also some large train cart animal cages, which are also used during the event.

Spin The Wheel Circus Tent appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Nuka-World on Tour* update.
